BILL DETAILS
SOURCES & METHODOLOGY

A map for exploration.

This MVP contains 17 selected bills enacted in 2025: nine in California and eight in Texas. It is a curated, source-checked sample, not a representative or complete inventory. States cannot be ranked from these counts.

What is sourced?

Historical enactment dates were checked against state legislature histories or governor announcements. Every bill has source links. Summaries are selective PolyViz paraphrases of those sources, with bill-specific scope notes. Source checking is by an AI assistant and is not independent legal review.

What still needs review?

Policy topics, issues and affected sectors are assistant-proposed demo labels, not verified classifier results. The map includes proposed labels by default. “Reviewed labels only” currently returns no bills.

How does the timeline work?

The slider includes sample bills signed on or before the selected month-end. Effective dates are separate. Verified dates or staged provision dates appear in bill details when available. Enactment does not establish current enforceability, impact or public support.

Coverage and geography

Only California and Texas have sample coverage. Gray states mean no coverage, not no laws. Bills can have multiple topics; map counts deduplicate bills. The map is not population-adjusted.

Source check: November 18, 2026. Boundaries: us-atlas, derived from U.S. Census boundaries. Map license.
